notes.title: Announcing Our First Ever Costume Contest!!
notes.content:
Hello, Duelists!

Today, the 10th of August, officially marks [b]7 years of development[/b] on Duels of Fortune! More time than any sane people should be spending on a single project, if we're being honest... but it's been time well-spent. And that's all thanks to you guys, our wonderful community who keep us going!

For our 7th dev anniversary, we wanted to do something to give back to the community that's carried us all this way. And so, it's our pleasure to announce the first ever...

[h1]Duels of Fortune Costume Contest![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/67efba60e5ebdf7db847023e698438858397b555.png[/img]
That's right! We want to see your most creative, wacky, and stylish ideas for new costumes, and our favourite ones will get the opportunity to be added to the game officially! Whether you've had cool concepts floating around in your head for ages, you're only thinking of some now, or you just want an excuse to dress up your favourite character in a silly outfit, this is your time to shine!!

Each participant can submit [b]up to 3 different costume designs[/b], as long as each design is for a different character. Once submissions close, we will choose [b]3-5 winners[/b], depending on how many submissions we get. Note that we will not select multiple designs created by the same person.

The contest starts [b]RIGHT NOW[/b], and will last until [b]September 10th[/b]! We hope one month will be enough time to ensure everyone who wants to submit a design is able to do so!

[h2]How to Submit[/h2]
Once you have a design ready, you can submit it through [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfwvGiTSh_PwvH1DCFW7MPQg4e1X75cuXq5LXQp_Hb2Ih8H3g/viewform?usp=header]THIS GOOGLE FORM[/url]! You're free to also share your designs on Discord or social media if you wish, but if you don't submit to the form, your submission [b]will not be counted!![/b]

[h2]The Rules[/h2]
[b][u]PLEASE READ THE RULES CAREFULLY BEFORE CREATING![/u][/b] Submissions that break the rules will be discarded!
[list]
[*] [b]MAIN PLAYABLE CHARACTERS ONLY[/b] - You may only submit costumes for any fighter on the main playable roster (including the guests!). We are not allowing submissions for costume-only characters (i.e. Roy, Ricky Travis, Shoto Goto, etc.) or boss-only characters (i.e. Masked Oni, Shade, Donner, etc.).
[*] [b]NO MATURE/18+ ELEMENTS[/b] -- This includes (but is not limited to): partial or full nudity, sexual suggestion, gore, and illicit drugs. Basically, just don’t submit anything NSFW or that we would otherwise normally avoid.
[*] [b]A VISUAL REFERENCE MUST BE PROVIDED[/b] -- This can take the form of a sketch, digital artwork, 3D render, or whatever other visual art form you're comfortable with! A description by itself is just not enough for us to go on, so even if you don’t consider yourself an artist, just do the best you can! Alternatively, consider collaborating with someone to help you with the art if you're not able to convey your idea on your own (see the later rule on collaboration for more info). [u]Submissions containing AI-generated artwork will not be accepted under any circumstances.[/u]
[*] [b]MAXIMUM OF 3 SUBMISSIONS PER PERSON[/b] -- A single participant may submit up to 3 individual designs if they desire. HOWEVER, you may not submit multiple costumes for the same character. We will also not be choosing multiple winning designs made by the same person, as that would be unfair to other participants.
[*] [b]COLLABORATION IS ALLOWED[/b] -- You are allowed to collaborate with others to create a design together, [u]so long as all contributors are credited by name[/u]. Also keep in mind that, for group submissions, each contributor will be counted separately towards the 3-costumes-per-person rule (i.e. if you submit 2 costumes on your own and 1 with a team, you will be considered to have submitted 3 costumes and cannot submit another).
[*] [b]NO CHARACTER REPACEMENTS[/b] -- You may not submit a costume that completely replaces the base character with a different one (i.e. costumes like Shin, Roy, Evilobster, etc.). Please also avoid submitting costumes that are just the character wearing another character's/your OC's outfit.
[*] [b]NO OUTSIDE REFERENCES/CROSSOVERS[/b] -- Costumes may not be directly based on, or be extremely obvious references to, any existing intellectual properties outside of Duels of Fortune. In the case of the guest characters, making costumes inspired by their home games is A-OK!
[*] [b]WE HAVE THE FINAL SAY ON WHAT GOES IN OUR GAME[/b] -- We reserve the right to tweak or modify the designs of any winning costumes if we so choose.[/list]
[h2]Additional Guidelines[/h2]
These are not hard and fast rules, but are some rough guidelines we ourselves use when designing costumes. We may be more likely to select costumes that follow these guidelines.
[list]
[*] [b]Avoid submitting a costume that is too similar to an existing one[/b]. To help with this, we have provided a handy reference sheet of all the costumes currently in the game, which you can view [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pfwaKs-KVRqbJwws18oNTJGjwcg7gDZOWdK_hNSNU90/edit?usp=sharing]HERE[/url]!
[*] [b]Consider a character’s personality and aesthetic when designing a costume for them[/b]. Costumes that “fit” a character in that way tend to feel much more natural and believable. Be creative in your approach of course, but try to avoid, for instance, giving a silly character like Derrick a particularly dark or edgy costume.
[*] [b]Avoid designs that drastically expand a part of a character’s base shape[/b] (such as adding a bulky accessory or large headwear to a character that doesn’t already have one). These can cause noticeable clipping issues during animations as well as make the bounds of a character’s hurtbox less clear.
[*] [b]Try to keep in mind a character’s animations and general structure[/b]. Avoid adding capes or other flowy elements that would require new animation to be done on them. If an item or piece of clothing is an essential part of a character’s animations (such as Sylvan’s hat), try to ensure your costume has an equivalent.
[*] [b]Avoid overly detailed designs[/b]. Duels of Fortune's art style is relatively simple, so too much detail in a design may stand out in a bad way.
[*] [b]Consider including supporting characters[/b]. If a character has any supporting characters in their moveset (such as Shiverskull’s crew, Chip, or Gizmo), try to think of designs for them to supplement the main costume. These extra characters do not have to be included in your visual reference, but we would still appreciate a description of how they should look at minimum.[/list]
We have also provided turnaround model sheets for every eligible character, which can be viewed and downloaded [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10spWpyV7_L60PodTNmWxjOVhrxC6IOyZ?usp=drive_link]HERE[/url]. You are free to use these as references for your artwork if you wish. And while we would encourage you to create an original artwork as your final submission piece, using these model sheets as a base to draw on top of may be helpful for getting your design down, especially if you have limited artistic experience.

Now that you understand everything, feel free to get creating! We can't wait to see what you all come up with!

notes.title: Catching Up! - July 2025 Status Update
notes.content:
Hey, Duelists!

Yesterday, our brand-new guest fighter Globule was finally released into the world! We're super happy to finally have her out for everyone to play, but we're also sure many of you have questions for us. It's been 7 months since Master Locks released, and new characters don't normally take us nearly that long. So why the heck did this one? We wanna take some time to catch you all up on where we've been, what's happened behind the scenes, and of course, give you some more insight into our latest crossover.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Duels of Fortune × Decline's Drops: Globule Joins the Fight![/h1]

Yep, in case you somehow haven't heard yet, our newest fighter is [b]Globule[/b], the protagonist of the punchy action-platformer Decline's Drops!!

[previewyoutube=8LZ4EH4YoaY;full][/previewyoutube]
We designed every aspect of Globule to feel like she was plucked straight out of her home game, with hard-hitting attacks, tons of movement options, delightfully stretchy animation, and even her own personalized meter system! Decline's Drops is essentially a singleplayer platform fighter, so it was a fun challenge translating her gameplay into a completely different kind of fighting game. She ended up as a highly mobile bruiser who can really put the pressure on her opponents, thanks to her unique meter mechanics and access to invincible dodges she can use to quickly reposition herself at the cost of a small amount of meter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/27bbb292ea240f23b13ee9287b5157337306d8f2.gif[/img]

Believe it or not, this collaboration has been planned for years, since long before Decline's Drops was even released! In fact, talks of it date all the way back to 2020 (!!!), so we're beyond excited to be able to finally welcome Globule into Duels of Fortune! Whether you're a fan of Decline's Drops, or just happy that the wait for a new character is over, you can get your gloves on and go play Globule [b]right now[/b], if you haven't already!

Speaking of the wait, though...

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Where Have We Been?[/h1]

Let's take some time to level with you guys a bit. We wanna be as transparent with you all as we can.

After the release of Master Locks, we stepped into 2025 with very high hopes. We knew that we were going to have more time than ever to work on the game this year, and we thought we knew how we were going to spend it. But, you know what they say about the best laid plans, right? Let's talk about what's happened, and why there's been such a long wait between new characters.

First, Ben's knee surgery, which we briefly mentioned in our last status update. First of all, the surgery went well, and he's been making a great recovery! Nothing to worry about there. However, the surgery also impacted Duels of Fortune's development a lot more than we expected. Since we knew that it was upcoming and that there would be a lengthy period afterward where development would be stalled, we didn't want to start any big, important things (like working on Globule) until after the surgery, so that they wouldn't be interrupted. It was a sound idea... [i]while we still thought the surgery was in February[/i]. But of course, as our luck would have it, it kept on getting delayed. We were completely in the dark about exactly when it would happen until it finally took place at the start of [i]April[/i]. So yeah, there was unfortunately just a long period where we didn't really feel like we could commit to anything important, which is why we instead spent a lot of that time working on the Fractured Fighters mode that was released in April. It was a fun distraction for us, but that's ultimately all it really was.

After that, though, we could actually start on the crossover content. Development on Globule properly began around mid-April, and we've been working on the update ever since. Characters don't normally take us over 3 months to finish, though -- and indeed, Globule has already been feature-complete since June, actually. Drazglb., the lead developer of Decline's Drops, wanted to have Globule's reveal be a part of the Decline's Drops Direct he was holding, and we had no reason not to accept. We knew we would love if something related to our game was became a big announcement for the Decline's Drops community as well! For any of you who may be coming to our game from the DD community because of that: Hello and welcome! Unfortunately, this plan required us to wait all the way until late July to finally release the character, even when she was already done for a while. We can only hope that she's been worth the wait for you guys!

As you can imagine, the long wait for the Decline's Drops Direct means we had a lot of downtime during this update cycle. So alongside the crossover content, we also took the time to tweak and refine a bunch of characters and system mechanics to improve the balance and feel of the game! It was some things we'd been wanting to address for a long time but never had a good opportunity to, like rethinking Callowman's overall design and toning down the maximum length and damage of combos. Overall, we feel the changes have been really healthy, and the flow of matches is better than ever before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/606f2adefa98e29a24dddfcbc61391304c6a0805.gif[/img]

The update also features lots of new costumes, as well as new Missions and stages! It's an update so packed, we had to make a whole overview trailer just to show off everything we made! You can check that trailer out below if you missed it.

[previewyoutube=5ACJO_pzO_4;full][/previewyoutube]
Also, if you want to keep up to date with future announcements, be sure to check out our [url=https://bsky.app/profile/cosmichatgames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] or [url=https://x.com/CosmicHatGames]Twitter (X)[/url] account. And if you wanna keep up with development AND hang out with the community, consider joining our official [url=discord.gg/R5vVYyR]Discord[/url] as well!

So yeah, in case you were worried that something serious was going on, we're all good -- we just had several back-to-back cases of unfortunate timing! Now that Globule is released, though, we're hoping to get right back on track and return to our usual character-making schedule!

And on that note, let's take another look at that fighter roadmap!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Future Plans[/h1]
[h2]The Next Fighter[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/c3bc94f1320a1e7c6988e580fb8cc3adfc1282de.png[/img]
Next up is a character (or rather, a pair of characters) that has been on the backburner for nearly 5 years now: the cosmic power couple [b]Miko & Mira[/b]! These two will feature a setplay-based moveset that highlights their teamwork-oriented fighting style, so we're expecting them to be pretty technical! You'll be frequently calling Mira to attack, so you'll have to manage both Miko's position and the position of the floating star that Mira appears from!

While we don't have much to show for these soulbound lovers, as we haven't made a start on them in-game yet, here's some early concept sketches for some of Miko's attacks! He'll be making good use of his massive signature weapon to boast some serious range!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/7b0a5b63e5cadbfaa442e3a4498157f0d452a879.png[/img]
All of this is subject to change, of course, but hopefully this little teaser gets you excited for these two to make their debut! We're certainly very excited to get working on them!

[h2]Story Mode[/h2]
Aside from that, there's the matter of [b]Story Mode[/b]. While we don't have much to directly say about it just yet, we just wanted to let you all know that we're still making steady progress on it! We estimate the writing is about 75% done now, and we've also recently begun working on the cutscene system again.

While we're no longer 100% confident that the first handful of chapters will be playable in-game by the end of this year, mainly thanks to the multiple delays we've faced, we're hopeful that at most the wait won't be much longer beyond that! Because trust me, the amount of time it's taken pains the two of us just as much as it probably does you -- if not more!

And that brings us to our last point on future content, and it's perhaps a less happy one...

[h2]Scaling Back[/h2]
Our desire to get Story Mode done and the game into a finished state is stronger than ever before. We want to focus all our energy on the important content from now on, and as a result, we've had to make some unfortunate sacrifices to our existing plans.

Most of the content we're scrapping is stuff that we hadn't revealed publicly anyway. Mainly some stages, bosses, and ideas for new singleplayer content. But, unfortunately, because of this we do have one piece of news that may be disappointing to hear: [b]we have made the decision to delay Punching Bag until post-launch[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/2307adc0e9cf5e766add13b8913808af85246eb7.gif[/img]

We understand this is probably a bit upsetting for some of you, as we know from our popularity poll last year that Punching Bag's playable debut was pretty highly anticipated. But truth be told, we've hit a bit of a roadblock with designing the little guy's moveset, and instead of scratching our heads over it, we'd currently rather put that energy into designing other fighters that are actually important to Story Mode.

Don't worry, this doesn't mean Punching Bag is gone forever! Like I said, he's just been [i]delayed[/i], not cut outright. While we can't promise anything, we can tell you that once the full game is released and Story Mode is complete, we'll do everything in our power to get him into the game in a playable form! Stay strong, Punching Bag fans! Your day will come!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Wrapping Up[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/0a14351f4134bf5fc7fc6e421a29e3c09963b677.gif[/img]

With that, we've shared everything we can for now! If Globule looks like a fun character to you, then... well, what are you waiting for?! She's out right now! She's BEEN out, even! Go play her, and show us what kinds of crazy things you can do with her!

Thanks for reading and for being patient with us for all this time. Have a great day, and we'll talk to you again once the next major update is on the horizon! Hopefully it won't take 7 months this time!

- Ben and Kaleb

notes.title: Globule Joins the Fight!! Version 0.11.0 is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Globule Joins the Fight!![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/dd116bdec6ca3b2daca492c786545794cab3c17c.png[/img]

Hello, Duelists! It's been a while since our last major update, but we're back, and with a brand-new guest character! Please welcome [b]Globule[/b] from Decline's Drops to the roster!

This crossover has been a long time coming, and we couldn't be happier to finally see the puppet in action! Even if you don't know the original game (though [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1500180/Declines_Drops/]you should totally check it out[/url] if that's the case), Globule's unique mechanics and playstyle make her a ton of fun on her own merits! We hope you enjoy putting on your oversized blue boxing gloves and smashing your opponents into the ground!

Aside from the Decline's Drops crossover content, we've also made some sweeping changes to the game's systems in this update, especially when it comes to combos. Most notably, Blast Burst has had its ability to reset combos greatly nerfed, leading to fewer situations where one player doesn't get to play for a whole round because they're stuck in a long combo. Here's a quick overview video of all the new things in this update, but if you want specifics, you can read the patch notes below!

[previewyoutube=5ACJO_pzO_4;full][/previewyoutube]
Speaking of which, here are the full patch notes for this update. It's a CHUNKY one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/4511aad036b83bba41fca053396b2abcafc705dc.png[/img]

[b]NEW FIGHTER[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Globule[/b] from Decline's Drops smashes into the fight! With both powerful attacks and impressive mobility at her disposal, this determined puppet is ready to do whatever it takes for the sake of her garden![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/72722acf000ed0f84a51de29038dcf201fccc853.png[/img]

[i]There's a looooong list of system changes here, but we had a few main goals in mind when making them:
[olist]
[*] Reduce the overall damage potential of longer combos to make touch-of-deaths more difficult
[*] Make it less effective to use the same moves repeatedly in a combo, without limiting what combos are possible
[*] Reduce the overwhelming impact that Blast Burst can have on the pace of a match
[*] Clean up miscellaneous issues and poor/outdated design decisions that have been left in the game for too long[/olist]Though most of these changes are technically nerfs, we've been finding the game a lot more fun and interesting since making them! The game is a bit less centralized around long combos now, which has led to far more back-and-forth matches with a wider variety of gameplay interactions! The changes may take some getting used to, especially for the diehard labbers out there, but we hope you'll come to enjoy them as much as we have![/i]

[b]Damage[/b]
[list]
[*] Using the same move multiple times in a combo now incurs a damage penalty on that move -- a system we are calling "stale moves". This penalty becomes stronger the more times an attack is used within the same combo, capping at a 75% damage reduction on the 4th use
[list][*] Special moves that are stale will also have their minimum damage scaling brought down to 20%. Super moves currently won't become stale at all
[*] Blast Burst resets the staleness of all attacks[/list][/list]

[b]Super Moves[/b]
[list]
[*] Using any Super move now reduces your Super Meter gain by 75% for 4 seconds (the same penalty that using a Reversal incurs)
[*] Using a Super near the opponent while they are in hitstun no longer adds to their hitstun time[/list]

[b]Blast Burst[/b]
[list]
[*] Blast Burst now only resets hitstun scaling by 3 steps instead of resetting it completely, greatly reducing the potential length of Blast Burst combos
[*] Blast Burst now resets damage scaling by only 40%, compared to the previous 60%
[*] Blast Burst now deals a fixed amount of histun, independent from hitstun scaling. This is to ensure it will always function the same as a combo extender even after the aforementioned nerfs
[*] Fixed an issue where landing a Blast Burst on an opponent right as they were floor bounced could cause the upward velocity to stack, launching them absurdly high
[*] Fixed an issue where using a Burst during a time where Blast Burst is unavailable (such as during a Super cinematic) would prevent you from using Burst until the animation of the move ended[/list]

[b]Blocking[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Block Button" control mode has been removed, with the default "Back-to-Block" now being the only available option. All CPU opponents have also been reprogrammed to use Back-to-Block instead of Button Block
[list][*] [i]This decision mainly comes down to the fact that it has become more and more difficult to accommodate the Block Button option as we've continued to balance, design, and bugfix around Back-to-Block primarily. This is especially true of the new character Globule, whose unique dodge mechanics would be largely incompatible with the Block Button mode due to being tied to the same button. Its existence was largely a legacy feature anyway, and from our observations the vast majority of players seem to prefer Back-to-Block. We apologize if you happen to be a rare player who preferred Block Button.[/i][/list][/list]

[b]Combo Bounces[/b]
[list]
[*] Any move affected by launcher decay that can also cause a wall bounce or floor bounce (such as Clyde's Inferno Upper) will no longer outright lose its ability to cause a bounce after the first use in a combo, instead properly using the "weak" bounce if the bounce has already been consumed
[*] Fixed an issue where two full wall bounces could occur back-to-back, if the move that caused the second wall bounce was started just before the opponent hit the wall from the first attack[/list]

[b]Grabs[/b]
[list]
[*] Characters caught in any grab (including command grabs) are now invincible to projectiles, as well as attacks from extra characters such as Chip (Lumina's puppet), until they are thrown. This prevents many different issues in which throws could be interrupted by projectiles, leading to janky results
[*] Breaking out of a grab now makes both players invincible until the end of the breaking animation, preventing lingering projectiles from giving either player an unfair advantage
[*] Fixed an issue where certain grabs (such as Shoto’s and Callowman’s) would start damage scaling at 100% instead of 90% when used as a combo starter[/list]

[b]Corner[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked the corner systems to allow you to jump over a cornered opponent if they are walking away from the corner, as previously this interaction produced strange-looking results[/list]

[b]Dashes[/b]
[list]
[*] Grounded backdashes are now invincible to throws for the first 6 frames of the animation[/list]

[b]Loop Prevention[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some moves with multiple possible IDs (such as moves with multiple selectable angles/versions) would not properly count towards loop escapes[/list]

[b]Projectiles[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where projectiles would sometimes ignore damage scaling and/or combo starter proration
[*] Fixed an issue where projectiles could clash with each other during Super cinematics
[*] Fixed an issue where certain multi-hitting projectiles would progress hitstun decay faster when used multiple times in a combo[/list]

[b]Button Remapping[/b]
[list]
[*] When you map an action to an input that's already being used by another action, the two mappings will now be properly swapped. Unassigned inputs are finally a thing of the past!
[list][*] [b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b] If you have any unassigned actions in your control settings, you will need to reset them manually. A prompt should appear on the rebinding screen to help you with this[/list][/list]

[b]Quick Rematch[/b]
[list]
[*] Selecting this option now instantly refills both players' HP, preventing issues where a player could be KO'd after the option was selected[/list]

[b]CPU Players[/b]
[list]
[*] CPU-controlled characters will now attempt to dodge certain attacks, mainly grabbing attacks, by jumping over them. The chance for them to do this scales with their difficulty level[/list]

[b]Music[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new music tracks to the Jukebox and stage select:
[list][*] One Big Frog -Power Mix- (by ModalModule, arranged by Jack7)
[*] One Big Frog (Original) (by ModalModule)
[*] Former Fields -BRK Mix- (by ModalModule)[/list][/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the action icons throughout the game (i.e. the Light/Medium/Heavy/Special icons)
[*] Fixed an issue where physics objects dropped by certain characters did not have the correct friction values (such as Johnson's hat and Guy's glasses)
[*] Updated the smoke particles from when a character is launched
[*] Characters now properly disappear after their "Star KO" animation, preventing issues where the model would linger in the background of some stages[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/cbb7716b618ef949dac8accd7cb34567d22cb15d.png[/img]

[b]All Menus[/b]
[list]

[b]Character Select[/b]
[list]
[*] Pressing the "toggle" button before selecting a character (the same button used to change costumes) now lets either player toggle between being a player or a CPU. This prevents Player 2 from being stuck as a CPU if Player 1 selects too fast, and also allows you to do CPU vs CPU matches if you want to

[b]Stage Select[/b]

[*] Added an "Auto" option to the stage select. Selecting this option will select a stage and music track to match one of the characters being played, picking randomly between player 1 and 2

[b]Pause Menu[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/e493e688709d6351430042a5c8ca79827148f724.png[/img]

[b]NEW STAGE: Former Fields[/b]
[list]
[*] A vast, colourful hillside, with scenery faithfully recreated from the first level of Decline's Drops! With hazards enabled, you can ring your opponents out off the sides of the stage, and attack poisonous mushrooms to create temporary platforms[/list]

[b]NEW STAGE VARIANT: Azu-Corps Holding Cells[/b]
[list]
[*] A variant of Azu-Corps Headquarters. The Azu-Corps keep all sorts of dangerous individuals locked up here, including any bosses you've defeated in Mission Mode, who can randomly appear in the cells in the background![/list]

[b]Unknown Plane[/b]
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/981c3af368d00472949c5d9875aca192d4820d44.png[/img]

[*] A new theme, "[b]Beach Party[/b]", is now available, in which characters will only wear swimsuits or other summer-themed costumes
[*] Added a new ruleset: [b]Hardcore[/b], a challenging mode which will truly test your skills!
[list][*] Your HP now carries over between each round and each fight, with only a small heal after winning a round. Getting a Perfect doubles the amount of health you recover
[*] Rounds you lose now act as lives, meaning that losing a round against one opponent will count that round as lost for every future opponent as well. And there are no continues here, either! Once you're out, you're out![/list][*] The “VS” screen now stays up a bit longer, even if loading has finished, to give you more time to process who you’re about to fight if your PC can load quickly

[*] The animations that play on the jumbotron between rounds can now be skipped

[previewyoutube=YMlm4DHxkmY;full][/previewyoutube]
Get ready for crazy antics in the new [b]Fractured Fighters mode[/b], the triumphant return of a cancelled game that nobody asked for (Except Doodle, probably)! With terrible balance, zero quality assurance, and approximately 80% less intentional game design than the base game, you're sure to wish you were playing almost anything else! Or maybe you'll like it, for some reason. Only one way to find out!

April Fools jokes aside, this update isn't just for sick kicks (even if it is mostly that). We've also added a brand-new stage, [b]Silver Stadium Lobby[/b]! Fighters from all around the world are gathered here in anticipation of the Duels of Fortune tournament, so you'll be able to spot lots of familiar faces in the background!

[list]
[*] The new Fractured Fighters gamemode for Arcade Mode (also unlockable for Versus matches!)
[*] A new Arcade Mode theme, Fractured Fighters, which features only characters who appeared in the cancelled game of the same name (including some unique CPU opponents!)
[*] A new stage, the Silver Stadium Lobby
[*] A new Mission
[*] A metric ton of bug fixes (special thank-you to SynCinn in our Discord for discovering and reporting the vast majority of these!)[/list]

This ruleset changes the game to be like a platform fighter, in which you must defeat your opponent by knocking them out of bounds 3 times! The knockback and hitstun of your attacks will also scale with the amount of damage your opponent has taken. Happy (late) April Fools, please enjoy this horribly unbalanced mess we've concocted!

Hey Duelists! Duels of Fortune Version 0.10.3 is out now, with the central new feature being the additional of [b]Tutorial Mode[/b]! We know many people have been asking for better learning resources for the game, as many new players seem to misunderstand or outright miss lots of core mechanics, so we hope that this mode will be the perfect solution! We've done our best to make the tutorials in a way that gets all the necessary information across concisely, but effectively, while injecting lots of fun personality into the whole experience.

While only the Basics section of the Tutorial is currently finished in its entirety, we are planning to add more tutorials with each update going forward, so eventually the whole thing will be filled out! If you have any suggestions for mechanics or interactions you'd like to see covered in the Advanced section in the future, let us know, because there's a very high chance that we have not thought of everything!

As most of you already know, the next major thing we will be working on is a new guest fighter! However, some complications have come up. Don't worry, the guest fighter will still happen, it just might take a bit longer than expected. Ben has an upcoming surgery scheduled for sometime within the next few weeks (we don't know when!), and he'll be completely out of commission for more than a week afterward. As such, we don't want to commit to any big projects such as a new guest fighter until the recovery period is over, so that we can have a smoother work flow when the time comes. Happy Holidays, Duelists! It's our final update of the year, and boy have we got a BIG present for you all! In case you somehow missed it, the lovable karate instructor [b]Master Locks[/b] has finally made his playable debut, and we couldn't be happier to have him here!

Master Locks is a somewhat unorthodox take on the typical "shoto" archetype, putting his own unique spins on each of his attacks, while also remaining a solid and dependable choice for beginners and experts alike! Moves like his steerable projectile [b]Buzz Cut[/b] and his long-ranged trapping move [b]Hair Extension[/b] let him play from a distance, while also having powerful mix-ups tools like [b]Hair Flip[/b] to go on the offensive! An all-around great moveset for an all-around great guy!

And of course, since we know everyone LOVES to get clothes for Crimbo, this update is also loaded with the most costumes we've ever packed into a single update! Master Locks himself is launching with 3 alternate costumes right out the gate, and we've also made 5 additional costumes for other characters! Shoto, Derrick, Lumina, Guy, and Johnson mains all have something nice to unwrap this year!

As a final message, we wanted to thank each and every one of you for just playing our silly little game, and for supporting it with reviews and by sharing the game with your friends and followers. 2024 has been an amazing year for Duels of Fortune, and that's all thanks to the wonderful community that's managed to grow around it. While we may not have the skills, time, or resources to provide big features like online play or mod support, we appreciate that you guys are largely understanding of that, and that you enjoy what we make regardless. Frankly, that alone means the whole world to us. ❤

We plan to make 2025 the game's biggest and best year yet. Hope you look forward to the future of DoF, and of course, have a happy new year!

notes.title: The Next Fighter: Master Locks! - December 2024 Status Update
notes.content:
Hey, Duelists!

It's been a while since we've done one of these status updates, but that's mainly because we've been focusing on a lot of more secrety stuff since releasing Lance. Between writing for Story Mode and creating content for the 0.10.0 update, we've been quite busy! But now it's time to show you what this update has in store, starting with the [b]brand-new fighter[/b] we've just unveiled...

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Stylish Master of Karate and Barbering, Master Locks![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/adf5828a932755bdec11bc30fb2ca61caf5c49db.png[/img]
That's right! Duels of Fortune's 21st fighter is none other than the fan-favourite karate-instructor-slash-hairstylist, [b]Master Locks[/b], finally making his playable debut!

[previewyoutube=HP3AQpBi2gc;full][/previewyoutube]
Master Locks has a fairly balanced playstyle, though slightly more geared towards offense, using his versatile hair-manipulation Aspect to play neutral from a distance, and his expert martial arts skills to challenge the opponent up close... all with his own signature brand of Locks Dojo stylishness! His moveset features lots of unique twists on familiar concepts, including a projectile that can be steered left and right at will, a leaping attack with multiple possible follow-ups on the way down, a ranged hitgrab that can immobilize the opponent, and even a command grab Super that can reach all the way across the screen! Despite his free-spirited and jovial attitude, Locks isn't playing around -- he's here to demonstrate his absolute mastery of his fighting style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/74ae4f10b92fdb2404e7aa71d9b5c2aa77c0c613.gif[/img]

Locks is likely the single most highly-requested character to join the playable cast, and we couldn't be happier to finally have him there! Truth be told, we've been planning him in secret for some time -- a couple years back, we realized just how much certain parts of the Story Mode would benefit from having him playable. But that's a discussion for later!

We hope you're all excited to school your opponents with Master Locks, when the 0.10.0 update drops on [b]December 29[/b]! Now let's get to talking about some of the other additions in the update...

[hr][/hr]
[h1]New Costumes![/h1]

In case you missed it, we'll be releasing quite a handful of costumes for existing characters in the update, as we tend to do. Let's take a look at them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/6248e3edfcec40f5e5d664b0b6b92856b8207934.png[/img]
This time, we're giving some love to several alt costume characters, by giving them costumes of their own! [b]Casual Shin[/b] (Shoto), [b]Burglar Roy[/b] (Guy), and [b]Pharaoh Rag-Z[/b] (Derrick) all bring fresh looks to these beloved second-fiddles. These three costumes will each be unlocked by beating Arcade Mode as the costume character in question.

And last, but not least...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/8b2937e0535d503f958f13e57714bc3f0cba8a41.png[/img]
[b]Chef Lumina[/b] is cooking up a storm! We've been neglecting to give Lumina as many costumes as we probably should, so hopefully this very silly one will make up for it! Really gives a whole new meaning to "putting them in the blender".

Of course, Master Locks will also be getting some costumes of his own, but we'll reveal those at a later date! Follow us on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/cosmichatgames.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] or [url=https://x.com/CosmicHatGames]Twitter[/url], or join our [url=discord.gg/R5vVYyR]Discord Community[/url] to keep up to date on every announcement we make!

This last announcement is regarding a feature that's been asked for a lot, and something we've admittedly been slacking on for far too long...

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Tutorial Mode![/h1]

Yep, we're finally giving Duels of Fortune a proper in-game tutorial! Not the most exciting announcement, we know, but we do plan to do some very interesting things with it! The tutorial mode will be hosted by none other than the new fighter, Master Locks, who is very excited to teach you all the ins and outs of fighting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/965fdb2529408c82c3af68f56880820f9ec9bdaf.gif[/img]

When going through the tutorials of other fighting games, we personally often find they're either too minimal to give you a solid enough understanding of the mechanics, or so long-winded that the only thing you learn from them is how to fall asleep at your computer. With Duels of Fortune's tutorial, we hope to strike just the right balance on this front, letting you get through things quickly while not spending too long on the nitty-gritty details (at least while you're still learning the ropes).

The tutorial will also be split into [b]three sections[/b]: Basic, Advanced, and Character. Basic and Advanced will both focus on game-wide mechanics, where Basic will teach you the fundamentals, and Advanced lets you tackle the more difficult mechanics and learn the intricate details of certain systems. The Character section, on the other hand, is comprised of lessons breaking down each character's moves and unique mechanics -- which will even be narrated by the character themselves! Note that you will have to complete the Basic section before moving on to Advanced or Character tutorials, just to ensure you can understand everything being shown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/defd4c20caac14bf2de18d38d3fb38f08d5e1689.png[/img]
There is one thing to note: [b]THERE IS NO GUARANTEE TUTORIAL MODE WILL BE ADDED IN THE 0.10.0 UPDATE[/b]. It's something we've been working on pretty on-and-off, so we currently have no idea if it'll be ready in time for Master Locks' release date. And even if we do finish it in time, it won't release with everything right off the bat -- [b]the Advanced section will be absent, and at most there will only be a few Character tutorials to start off[/b]. Advanced and Character lessons are something we plan to add slowly over the course of multiple future updates, until we're fully caught up on everything. Getting the Basic tutorial done and released is our absolute priority.

Regardless, we hope many of our newer or more casual players will appreciate this addition to the game! We want Duels of Fortune to feel inviting and accessible, even to those who have never touched a fighting game before, so this should help bring us a bit closer to that goal!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Our Plans for 2025[/h1]

2024 has been a great year for Duels of Fortune! This was our first year on Steam, and because of it, the game has reached way more people than we ever thought it would! We've even managed to faintly catch the attention of some pretty notable figures in the fighting game community (BIG shoutouts to those who've been submitting DoF clips to Will It Kill!). Perhaps most importantly, though, is that we managed to hit tons of personal goals for the year! Once Locks is out, we'll have released 4 new characters, all of which are needed for Story Mode! It feels like we've made some real progress!

Speaking of characters, let's take another look at that roadmap to see who you guys can expect to join the roster in 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/ddbc1c9bc7405de588f3cd3efd3d4a86af4c5540.png[/img]
The first fighter of the new year will be a brand-new [b]guest fighter[/b]! It's been quite a while since Johnson and Ember were first added, so it's about time we introduce a fresh face to the guest character club! Like the previous two, this character will come from a fellow indie game... but of course, our lips are sealed on their exact identity! Who do you think it'll be?

After that, it's the long-awaited [b]Miko Starfinder[/b]! Him and his partner Mira were originally part of the closed beta, being first added all the way back in December of 2020, but soon enough this cosmic power couple will be ready to make their proper debut! They'll be followed shortly after by another [b]mystery fighter[/b], and this is one we've been holding onto for even longer than Master Locks!

Beyond that, we're not yet entirely sure who will be next, but we have a much bigger goal for 2025 anyway: [b]Story Mode[/b]! We are going to do EVERYTHING in our power to make sure that at least the first few Story Mode chapters are released by the end of next year. The script is nearing completion at this point (about 3/4 done), and once it's finalized, we'll waste no time getting to work on the mode itself.

From the very beginning, Duels of Fortune's story has been our top priority. So, while we'll try to keep up the usual pace of our playable character releases, know that they might end up taking a back seat for Story Mode when we're ready to work on it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/616cd48f4efc1ef78599fd66dfdb443703f28ecf.gif[/img]

And that's all we have to share for now! Hopefully this post has given you lots to look forward to for the end of the year and beyond! Duels of Fortune has been around for a painfully long time by now, but we can assure you that the real fun is just getting started! Have a happy holidays, Duelists! We'll see you next year!

- Ben and Kaleb

[olist][*] [i]It is surprisingly time-consuming to create renders for each individual alternate colour of every costume, especially given we had to do this twice per costume (once for the character select screen renders, and again for the health bar portraits). Eliminating one of these sets will save us a lot of time in the long run[/i]

Hello Duelists! We've released an update with fixes for various bugs found within the first week of Lance's release. Thank you to everyone who has reported these bugs to us! notes.content:
[h2][b]Lance Marshall[/b] joins the fight![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/ba6f125e4db91dd26f5e81b32195632769187a07.gif[/img]

Howdy, pardners! In this here Duels of Fortune update, saddle up to have a hollerin' good time playin' as the newest cowboy on the ranch...

No never mind I will not be writing the patch notes like that.

Anyway, yes, he's FINALLY here! The wild, gunslinging mercenary [b]Lance Marshall[/b] joins the Duels of Fortune roster! Considering this character was first announced nearly 6 years ago (dear lord), he was LONG overdue to be added to the playable cast, and we couldn't be happier to see him in action after all this time!

For a quick overview: Lance is a [b]mid-range zoning[/b] character who uses his arsenal of gun-based attacks to lock down the stage and keep the opponent at bay. Between ricochet shots with [b]Deadeye[/b], access to multiple types of guns with [b]Golden Arsenal[/b], and extra support with [b]HE Grenade[/b], Lance features one of the largest arrays of projectile attacks in the game!

The other major feature of this update is a moveset overhaul for Ember!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/b55fe1c263dc92327452db139dcc546b7011852b.gif[/img]

We've updated her Spin Attack special move to make it a core mobility tool for her, and we've added several new moves to help flesh out her existing kit! She's feeling like a brand-new slime! Note that some of her moves now have different inputs to accommodate the changes, but she certainly hasn't lost what made her fun before. She's just become much more rich and focused!

Aside from that, this version also adds the usual new costumes, new Missions, and a healthy dose of bug fixes, albeit much less of all three than usual. The characters were really the focus of this update!

notes.title: More Mission Mode Overhauls! Version 0.8.5 is Live!
notes.content:
Heya, Duelists!

We've released another "between characters" update, this time focused primarily on improving the experience of playing through Mission Mode.

While we were fixing some bugs related to certain Missions, we decided on a whim to take the time to go through each Mission and evaluate their relative difficulty and overall quality, and we ended up tweaking a large number of Missions as a result. Some Missions have seen an increase in their challenge or complexity, others have had their more frustrating elements toned down, and others still have just been spiced up in some way to make them more fun and interesting!

Even though the list of changes is already INCREDIBLY long, we still didn’t quite have time to make all the additions and adjustments we wanted to. We’re hoping we’ll be able to fit in the rest of these changes in the next major update alongside the 20th playable fighter, Lance Marshall. While we can't 100% promise anything, said update is currently on track to release later this month!

[b]NEW:[/b] Projectile Clashing System
[list]
[*] Each projectile in the game now has a priority value assigned to it. When two projectiles collide, their priority values are compared against each other, and one of various different interactions can occur depending on each projectile's priority and the number of hits it has.
[list][*] If one projectile has a higher priority value than the other, it will destroy the weaker one and continue on its path
[*] If both projectiles have the same priority and hit count, they will clash, destroying each other
[*] If a multi-hitting projectile is involved in a same-priority clash, it will use up one of its hits, but will not be immediately destroyed. If both projectiles still have hits left, they will repeatedly clash until one of them is destroyed (or both of them, if they deal the same number of hits)
[*] [i]Note that most projectiles range in priority from -2 to 3, but Super projectiles typically have varying values in the double digits. If you want to know the priority of any given projecitle, the new "Extra Projectile Data" option in Training Mode will allow you to easily view both the priority value and hit count of any projectile you use![/i][/list][/list]

notes.title: The Next Fighter: Yosei Kanji! - June 2024 Status Update
notes.content:
Hello, Duelists!

We hope you've all been doing well! We've got a new status update post for you today, this time focusing heavily on what's new in the upcoming 0.8.0 update! So let's not waste any time and get right into it, starting with undoubtedly the biggest piece of news...

[hr][/hr]
[h1]The Tidal Assassin, Yosei Kanji[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/cf58fc17723ca8d86c0afe7e6b603736b5694265.png[/img]
Just earlier today, we officially revealed Duels of Fortune's 19th playable fighter: [b]Yosei Kanji[/b], a trained assassin with a mastery of the katana, and the estranged elder sister of Shoto. Wielding her blade, her powerful "Suijin" Aspect, and her two different stances, Yosei will be making some serious waves in the arena!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/d49ee05f4436ca10993c3e106006e1ab4f73d02f.gif[/img]

Yosei has the unique privilege of being able to switch her stance, effectively giving her two different movesets in one! Each stance has its own strengths and weaknesses, but there is also some special interplay between the two, encouraging you to constantly switch it up! Yosei always starts the battle in [b]Iaido style[/b], a defensive stance in which she wields precise, long-ranged attacks, but has limited damage output and offensive capabilities. She can keep the opponent away, and can maybe put on the pressure if needed, but has trouble capitalizing on it. By using her Down Special, however, you can switch to [b]Tsunami style[/b], where Yosei's offense really shines! Tsunami style lets you go wild, crushing the opponent's defenses and comboing to your heart's content, dealing some serious damage in the process! You even gain access to a strong projectile which travels along the ground, letting you control the opponent's position more easily.

So what's the catch? [i]All your command normals and Special Moves in Tsunami style drain your HP.[/i] All the water she uses with her Aspect has to come from somewhere, and it turns out that a part of it is the water in her own body. You'll have to be very careful with how you use this stance so as not to damage yourself more than you're damaging the opponent... OR you can gather some helpful Koi Spirits to prevent that self-damage in the first place! You'll gain a Koi Spirit if you hit the opponent with the VERY tip of your Focus Slash attack in Iaido style, and they'll activate automatically when you use a self-damaging move in Tsunami style, immediately giving back the HP you lost. These Koi Spirits have some other uses too (one of which may or may not involve a giant dragon), but we'll wait until Yosei's official Character Showcase to talk more about that! This section's already pretty long as is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/2e9353b5fe713b01d7b4fb50436bc72c99457c0f.gif[/img]

Regardless, we hope you look forward to playing as Yosei when she crashes in this July! We'll announce an exact release date once we're more confident we can provide one.

There's more to look forward to in the Yosei update as well, including a new mechanic that's been requested by the community for some time...

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Projectile Clashing[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/24cea1275d46b79fa3188004296bb6557b76b8af.gif[/img]

For as long as Duels of Fortune has existed, opposing projectiles have always simply passed through each other... until now! In the 0.8.0 update, projectiles will now collide with each other in various ways, depending on the priority value of the two projectiles. In general, projectiles of the same priority will clash, destroying each other, while projectiles with higher priority will beat the lower ones clean! There's other factors involved, such as the fact that projectiles that hit multiple times will always win in clash scenarios, but this is the basic idea!

This has opened up a lot of interesting new strategies for certain characters, letting them counter projectiles in ways they couldn't before! Callowman, for instance, has the rock from his Crouching Heavy, which now beats pretty much any projectile that doesn't come from a Super Move! And Johnson's Down Super, in which he throws his buddy Shaz, has the highest projectile priority in the game! It even beats out other Supers, giving him a surefire way to stop a projectile-happy opponent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/30d2ece75043055b8703d443ec42cfd108f3ba62.gif[/img]

There's still some kinks to iron out with this system, but we still have plenty of time to do so before the update's release, so don't worry!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]New Costumes![/h1]

With us, a new update almost always means new costumes, and this one is no exception! With the summer season rolling in, some of our fighters have been finding their own ways to beat the heat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/5d053d48fd8227b4e61cfc68777c91769757844a.png[/img]
[b]Beachwear Clyde[/b] and [b]Shark Prank Black Heart[/b] will be rolling in for the 0.8.0 update, and [b]a third summer-themed costume[/b] is on the way too! We'll announce it over on [url=https://x.com/CosmicHatGames]our Twitter/X account [/url] when it's ready, so make sure to follow us over there to see what we're cooking!

The summer costumes aren't the only ones, either! With this update introducing a new member of the Kanji family, it's only right that Shoto gets a costume for the occasion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/e844ddd7173e450c56a202c948f5e9bb0986d943.png[/img]
[b]Thunder God Shoto[/b] is quite the striking sight, but given his so-called "Raijin" Aspect, it's certainly a look that lives up to the name!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]So What's Next?[/h1]
The grind doesn't stop after the Yosei update releases in July, as we'll be setting our sights straight onto the next fighter! Who will that be? Well, how about we do you four better and show you our plans for the next [b]FIVE[/b] fighters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/328494e88d82282467ba386a7e775b732c2e3cf4.png[/img]
While our favourite gunslinger Lance was already very likely to be the next fighter after Yosei, his victory in the popularity poll as the "Most Anticipated Upcoming Fighter" cemented his spot. Being one of the oldest known characters planned for the Duels of Fortune roster, first revealed all the way back in 2018 (before even now-foundational characters like Annie and Sylvan!), it's about time we finally brought him into the game proper!

After that, we'll be working on a secret mystery fighter, followed by our third guest character! We're very excited for both of these, and we hope you guys will be excited to see them when they're ready! And finally, for the furthest-out of the bunch, it'll be the duo fighter Miko Starfinder, then yet another mystery fighter! To be honest, we're still deciding between a couple candidates for that last slot, so even [i]we[/i] don't know exactly what to expect yet! But whoever it is, we'll of course make sure they're a worthwhile addition to the cast!

We're not ready to give release windows for any of these upcoming characters just yet (we've been bitten by that before!), but we're at least hoping to have Lance and the fighter after him both done by the end of the year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/6b4f3857babedef663695651950c4dea9f0315e4.gif[/img]

In any case, that's all from us for now! We hope this status update has given you plenty to look forward to, for the next update and beyond! See you all next time!

- Ben and Kaleb

notes.title: Character Popularity Poll Results!
notes.content:
Hello Duelists!

Duels of Fortune's first-ever Character Popularity Poll has ended, with an absolutely astounding [b]103 RESPONSES[/b] submitted! You guys SERIOUSLY shattered our expectations with this, thank you so much to everyone who voted!

We know what you're here for though, so let's not waste any time! Here are the results for each category!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Favourite Fighter[/b] (Gameplay)[/h1]
For the playable fighters, we split the voting into two categories: favourite gameplay, and favourite character.

In the gameplay category, the vote actually ended with a TIED first place! But which fighters' playstyles were the most beloved of all? Well...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/22cb2a601f50b52abfb23b079ae1af64c6a8af15.png[/img]
It was none other than our karate boys, [b]Shoto Kanji[/b] and [b]Derrick Stone[/b]! Quite the amazing coincidence! And as a cherry on top, our beloved guest character [b]Ember[/b] from Hyper Team Recon is right behind them in third!

Here are the full results from this category:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/cd3105a60c7362654f37ddede669105f03b44b6e.png[/img]
In a sad, yet painfully fitting tragedy, Guy didn't manage to get a single gameplay vote. Keep your chin up, bud — you'll get 'em next time. Maybe.

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Favourite Fighter[/b] (Character)[/h1]
This is the category we were personally most interested in. With Story Mode still being in the works, all that's available on the characters is lore entries and snippets of dialogue from match quotes, and we were very curious to see how the fighters would stack up with just that much to go off.

If you can believe it, this category ALSO had a tied first place in the end! What are the chances?! Let's see who in our cast resonated with you guys the most...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/31bd095585654850190fe1bb350d84740d9a59a9.png[/img]
Our main man [b]Clyde Brightstar[/b] ties with [b]Derrick Stone[/b] for first place, with [b]Lumina Blackjack[/b] as a very close third! ...Wait, Derrick again?! Yeah, you guys REALLY seem to like him on both the gameplay AND character fronts, and we can hardly blame you. He's just such a loveable, goofy guy!

We're very happy to see Clyde at the top as well, seeing as he's going to be the main protagonist of Story Mode. If you guys are fans of him now, just you wait!

Full results:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/01674b28ff2282499d53db866e4a237e88f8d2ca.png[/img]
Unlike the previous category, not a single character was left unvoted for, which we're VERY happy to see! Poor Shoto though, all alone in last place...

You may also notice that we left the guests, Johnson and Ember, out of this category. Those characters were of course created by their respective owners, not us, so it didn't feel right to include them here. In their places, we added Shin and Roy Urboi as options, two costume characters who will both appear in Story Mode (albeit, with one of them having a MUCH more prominent role than the other). We were quite impressed to see them manage 3 votes each!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Favourite Fighter[/b] (Combined)[/h1]
Just for fun, we decided to take the combined totals of both the playable fighter categories, and put them into a single list!

Not gonna bother with a big reveal here, because the results here should be apparent based on the previous two categories. So here are the full results right away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/7706712027515248b0569721dbdfc5b12b2c3559.png[/img]
In terms of average rating across both categories, [b]Derrick[/b] is unsurprisingly the favourite by a landslide, with [b]Lumina[/b] following as a convincing second place, and [b]Clyde[/b] and [b]Shiverskull[/b] tying for third! Despite not placing top 3 in either category, the Captain still got enough votes in total to sneak his way there when the votes were combined!

Also, despite only being selectable in one of the two categories, Ember somehow managed to outplace ERROR, Guy, AND Callowman in total votes. CALLOWFANS, WHERE ARE YOU AT?!

With the playable fighter results now out of the way, it's time to get into the results for the optional bonus categories! These proved to be quite interesting in their outcomes, so let's check them out!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Favourite Costume Character[/b][/h1]
We simply HAD to give some love to our cast of alternate costume characters, with how cool and unique many of them are. That being said, it was almost inevitable who the uncontested top spot would go to...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/c31828a1660dcedf5b2a8814eb2b2e8e33191812.png[/img]
It's the mother-anglin' [b]Evilobster[/b], baby! Being such a popular character in his own game, Schwarzerblitz, it's no surprise that he would be just as beloved in Duels of Fortune! [b]Shin[/b] and [b]Roy Urboi[/b] ended up tying for second place below him, which is very nice to see!

Full results:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/45042741ea4b3b2bb75256ce9c4d24ada5628683.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Favourite Boss Character[/b][/h1]
This category received 94 votes, which was the least of any category, but that's still more than enough to see some solid results! So which boss is the boss of them all? According to you guys, it's...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/4e94b46ce9f2b65c729543c2268724d8e1fa048d.png[/img]
The Arcade Mode secret boss, [b]Masked Oni[/b]! Seems his mysterious nature and fast-paced battle made him quite a memorable opponent! Trailing behind him with a pretty sizable gap is [b]The Pill[/b], followed by [b]Tiny Evil Clyde[/b]. The sillier bosses also turned out to be quite popular.

Full results:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/a88b75855df42cc1784109eac500ef018cda34c9.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Favourite Summon Character[/b][/h1]
The companions that some of the playable characters fight alongside are important, too! We felt it was only right to give them some dedicated appreciation. However, one of them in particular ended up completely sweeping this category, and you might be able to guess who...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/29d62f0024168a2064f6e4f1a62cf803cfe83483.png[/img]
It's [b]Chip Blackjack[/b], Lumina's undead brother-slash-puppet, who received a whopping 43.2% of the votes in this category! Sylvan's bodyguard [b]Withers[/b] and Annie's robotic helper [b]Gizmo[/b] took second and third place respectively, but neither were particularly close to matching Chip's dominant placement.

Full results:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/a7e629fad84a20c6389a11ee50de262f860cc294.png[/img]
Sadly, none of Shiverskull's crew managed to crack the top 3, sitting at the bottom instead. Better luck next time, mateys!

It only occurred to us after the voting began that we probably should've included Derrick's dog Rocky and Johnson's sharkman friend Shaz in this category as well. Oh well, they can show up on the next poll!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Favourite Non-Playable Character[/b][/h1]
This was the category that shocked us the most. While the frontrunner wasn't too surprising, it was most of the results beyond that which made us either pop off or scratch our heads in confusion. That being said, I think most of you already knew who would be leading the pack here...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/2438e6935f7ff9f79819c391b814740a934224eb.png[/img]
First place by a landslide goes to [b]Master Locks[/b], the karate instructor/hairstylist who has already captured the hearts of many fans! In second place is the King of Hell himself, [b]Collin Calcium[/b], and third place is a tie between [b]The Shadow[/b] and... [b]Wood Demon[/b]... we can only assume that he was carried by the memes.

Full results:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/b0085b22c00a3f80beb60f83348aa7a3809b5880.png[/img]
It's mostly the silly characters who ended up near the top, but our boy Bronze has done quite well for himself, too! How a creature like Cain the Cane has received 4 entire votes is beyond us, but we won't judge.

We will, however, be introducing more NPC lore entries starting in the Azutron update! That way, you folks will actually have something more concrete to go on for the next time we do a poll like this! Plus, it's always fun to learn about the characters who don't get much time in the spotlight, right?

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Most Anticipated Fighter[/b][/h1]
Out of the upcoming fighters who are publicly known, we wanted to see who was the one people are most excited about! And the results are quite intriguing...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/f7cde91cabf70f82d308a2cb0b1ffd0e3b11bb1e.png[/img]
The gunslinging mercenary [b]Lance Marshall[/b] is undoubtedly the most hyped of the bunch! Below him, the duo fighter [b]Miko Starfinder[/b] and the sports/workout-themed [b]Punching Bag[/b] were constantly trading second place throughout the week, so the fact that they ultimately tied for it in the end is quite poetic. Finally, we have the soon-to-release [b]Azutron S-Type[/b], who we assume probably didn't do as well since he's already nearing completion, and the majority of his moveset is publicly known. He doesn't quite have that mystery factor to him anymore, like the other three do.

Do note that these results won't affect the order in which we develop fighters. However, luckily for you many Lance fans, he's already planned to be coming later this year, so look forward to that!

Before him, though, the next fighter after Azutron will be a surprise. A mysterious "samurai" who we've been holding off on revealing for several years... we hope you're excited to hear about them once they're ready!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Grembo[/b][/h1]
Grembo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/80cd39f0865a7828331b119437ab2a0ce2aa367b.png[/img]
Grembo.

[hr][/hr]
And that's the results! Once again, we'd like to thank everyone who took the time to fill out the form. If you missed your chance, don't worry, because we'll definitely be doing one of these again once Story Mode is at least partially released. By then, there'll no doubt be even more characters to choose from!

For now, though, we'll continue to work hard on bringing more characters and content to the game, and work our way towards our ultimate goal of Story Mode! The Azutron update is entering the final stretch now, so the wait shouldn't be much longer!

Thank you all so much for your continued support of Duels of Fortune! We'll see you again very soon!
- Ben and Kaleb

notes.title: "Where's Azutron?" - April 2024 Status Update
notes.content:
Hello, Duelists!

We hope you're all still enjoying Duels of Fortune, especially after the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2371130/view/4016716939425521398]massive balance & polish update[/url] that was released a little over a month ago! We think the game's been feeling a lot better since then!

Recently, we've realized we may have a bit of an unintentional communication problem. While we do speak very actively with the community on our [url=discord.gg/R5vVYyR]official Discord server[/url], both about DoF and about other random topics, we failed to realize just how many of our fans lie outside of that Discord community! As such, we're going to make an effort from now on to keep all of you much more updated on DoF's development with these Steam news posts, perhaps using them as monthly devlogs of sorts. We want to make sure no one is left out of the loop for too long!

That being said, let's not waste any more time, and get into the topics we want to focus on today. Starting with the most important question...

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Where's Azutron?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/952cef12e872d2810f275322168be4f5a344bf50.gif[/img]

As many of you may know, our next character, [b]Azutron S-Type[/b], is currently in development. However, he was originally scheduled for release in late February, and it's April now, so... what gives?

We won't beat around the bush here -- development has been a lot slower than we'd like. Not only do we now [i]both[/i] have jobs outside of game development (whereas previously only one of the two of us did), but the aforementioned balance patch took also a lot longer than we expected, which pushed back Azutron's development significantly.

That being said, he's relatively close to being done now! Currently, we're predicting Azutron to release [b]before the end of April[/b], but of course any number of unexpected factors could still delay it further. We'll do everything in our power to stick to this window, though!

It's also worth mentioning that Azutron hasn't been the only thing taking up our dev time lately, as the scope of the 0.7.0 update has increased a decent bit beyond just adding him. But hey, at least that gives us some exciting new things to show off in this post! Let's start with one you may have already heard about...

[hr][/hr]
[h1]He's Got a Gun?![/h1]

[previewyoutube=6v74IVMDGuw;full][/previewyoutube]
For our April Fools announcement this year, we unveiled a "brand-new character" in [b]Callowman With a Gun[/b]!

While this altered version of Callowman isn't actually being added to the roster proper, he'll still be featured in the game as a special Mission Mode opponent. After beating him, however, you WILL actually unlock the ability to play as him, as long as you have Boss Mode enabled! Just hold Start while selecting Callowman, and you'll get to wield all that ungodly power for yourself!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]New Stage: Sylvan's Office![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/7d5a41aa68684868489d15c956a32c83e0dd5b9c.png[/img]
Every narcissistic, larger-than-life billionaire needs an equally larger-than-life work suite, and the new [b]Sylvan's Office[/b] stage shows just how luxuriously the sleazy gambling tycoon likes to spend his "working" hours.

As you can see by all the gold trimming and tacky art pieces, Sylvan really spares no expense... on himself, anyway. Keen-eyed players may even be able to spot some hidden details among the display shelves in the back!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]New Boss Battle: Azutron T-Type![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/c1cc015c19202ccbc150baeb114dd1382b8cb393.png[/img]
As the powerful, interdimensional militaristic force they are, the Azu-Corps naturally must have some heavy artillery, and the [b]Azutron T-Type[/b], A.K.A. "[b]Gigatron[/b]", is exactly that!

Players who dare to face this gargantuan foe will have to contend with an onslaught of hard-hitting attacks, trapping projectiles, and a shielding system that prevents Gigatron from being flinched or launched until you deal enough damage! As the "T-" in his designation implies, he's an absolute tank, and you'll need to use both heavy offense and extreme caution if you want to take him down!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/11e7e464ec50f8f4f4aa8a777c05fee60dbdb3f3.gif[/img]

The Gigatron fight will take the form of a new Boss Mission in Mission Mode! Good luck to all challengers!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]And Finally... A Character Popularity Poll!![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/dcd0098424488951ccfc5da425b381e88b3fd96e.png[/img]

With Duels of Fortune having been available on Steam for a good few months (and well over a YEAR on smaller storefronts!), it feels long overdue for us to hold our first-ever [b]character popularity poll[/b]!

Who do you like playing the most? Have a soft spot for a particular character's personality or lore? Maybe you even have a favourite background character! Well now's your chance to finally tell us all of that and more! This character poll is all-encompassing, including categories about way more than just the playable cast! While any question about non-playable characters is optional, we'd highly encourage you to try to answer them all anyway, as we're very curious about who the most beloved in each category will be!

Link to the full form: [url=https://forms.gle/wHs7cpHpyu1wShsk7]Click here![/url]

With Story Mode not being out yet, we're very interested to see people's opinions based on just the brief lore and interactions that are currently in the game! [b]Voting will only be open until April 14, 2024[/b], so don't miss your chance!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Wrapping Up[/h1]
And that covers everything we wanted to talk about in this post! As mentioned before, we'll be making an effort to release posts like this on a more regular basis now. Even if we don't have much to talk about in a given month, we'll still do our best to keep you all updated on our current activities!

With that, we wish you a great day, and we hope you're looking forward to all the exciting new content coming in the Azutron update! See you around!

- Ben and Kaleb

notes.title: HUGE Balance Update!! Version 0.6.4 is Live!
notes.content:
We're back! For real this time!!

In this massive balance and polish update, we've done our best to refine [b]nearly every aspect of Duels of Fortune's gameplay[/b]! Not only have many of the universal systems have been tweaked, but almost every character has gotten some amount of balance changes too, with Clyde and Sylvan in particular even getting [b]brand-new moves[/b]! We've also added some new costumes, Missions, and music tracks to enjoy!

Outside of new character additions, this might be the biggest update in Duels of Fortune's history! We hope you all enjoy the new changes, and we can't wait to finally get back to working on characters! Next up, the Azutron update!

Here are the (VERY LONG) patch notes for this update. We won't blame you for not reading them all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/72722acf000ed0f84a51de29038dcf201fccc853.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/98de6597c8fed6cd37734f993cfec31f3e64b389.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/cbb7716b618ef949dac8accd7cb34567d22cb15d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/488b32e2c9f71f8af83a722cccbb5a9a49dc5e52.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/e493e688709d6351430042a5c8ca79827148f724.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/64f7dbd3a9be86d1ca97314b5ebdccd0b3d18dfc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/981c3af368d00472949c5d9875aca192d4820d44.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/f5051a87559c7b0dbc315f93928e4b76d937c482.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/6bacad961bbdbdf0a560c76a9f1d7bf1aeaacfb2.png[/img]

[b]MAJOR OVERHAUL[/b]

Clyde was the first character ever developed for the game, and that age was starting to show in both his visuals and the overall feel of his moveset. So, we decided to give him a big overhaul! Many of his animations and visual effects have been redone from scratch, certain moves have been touched up in their functionality, and he's even got a brand-new move to play with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/2ad6ac377d64a663df5de0c9fd771b84720999b8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/292503c199498a831a5c10640f6ad61ffed217ab.png[/img]

[b]MODERATE TWEAKS[/b]

Annie didn't have much wrong with her, and in fact is still one of the characters we're proudest of to this day! She's nonetheless received a few changes to help her better integrate her Portable Supercharged Tesla into her zoning, as well as a few other miscellaneous tweaks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/f1deab149defd708da0de69a7a76d4dc01d01108.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/27206fe9a09bba9aae079e839c40e385be022453.png[/img]

[b]MODERATE TWEAKS[/b]

While Rattlebone is very much supposed to be effective at almost everything, some of his moves were a bit overtuned, making him stronger than intended in some areas. His changes are few, but they should help reign him in significantly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/c68385c8d22b528f414fa4dac2bda515524a6df8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/3f2a0a32ea43c1116c67642d45ea454a3675730a.png[/img]

[b]MODERATE TWEAKS[/b]

Shoto's offense is pretty oppressive by design, but this could make him quite frustrating to fight at times. We've toned down some of his more obnoxious elements, such as his projectile game and his block pressure, while keeping his big damage and combo game largely untouched.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/40c84a3f9de052b70bb87db899f4ef2fcfdbafab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/fe64d5744eef4a0e5c7f2e9021ee75a750032600.png[/img]

[b]MINOR TWEAKS[/b]

Derrick was largely fine, so we didn't touch him much. He has received some small nerfs, but they're mainly in the interest of correcting some oversights, and don't greatly affect his gameplay. He does get a cool new costume, though!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/2503213bce0809310b8d218b962f408681f2732d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/13fe29bfe526f3587b81d6785f3dd53a0988592f.png[/img]

[b]MODERATE TWEAKS[/b]

Red's gotten a few nice buffs, including two new ways to secure a Hard Knockdown, which helps really drive in his bullying playstyle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/76f977485ce4fa511406a0cecfe42fe8d1077e8a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/be20082ae966740f8ba0a7043182eeb68590af70.png[/img]

[b]MINOR TWEAKS[/b]

While he wasn't desperately in need of changes, Baron's regular Brightstar Bomber has gotten the same treatment as its Grand counterpart for combos, since it was previously possible to use it many times in a combo with little drawback if timed correctly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/04a73bdb94dd6bd9bbfb3a73ed07114c7717e8e5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/4679fc48e806324aa72cd4a7dc16c98b762f55d0.png[/img]

[b]MODERATE OVERHAUL[/b]

Sylvan's got a wealth of new options to play with, thanks to a complete overhaul of his Slot Machine special! The changes make working your way up to Full House Mode much more engaging and interesting, as there are even more possible routes to achieve your goals, and lots of new considerations to make in regards to the order you collect Aces!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/318712e2173f0600935f63715c76154e5ab40c36.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/2d862488c0a2c5d7b70bb96649abc9b50a867a24.png[/img]

[b]MODERATE TWEAKS[/b]

A few miscellaneous changes, but the big one is that Shiverskull's crew can now be hit by the opponent's attacks, making his crewmate pressure a bit less safe overall. On the bright side, though, he's looking sharp with his new costume!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/8ddb35e971cece7746d674a481c25ef44c04274b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/0e44b78226c5e95bfd6f14f52864f618f2a5b369.png[/img]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]

Just some good 'ol bug fixes for her! While Lumina does seem to be a very strong character, there's nothing in particular that we feel confident in changing about her right now. A puppet character in a game as free-form as Duels of Fortune is bound to be powerful, after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/39c8442cf87cfc26494d8abb2d78ab0f53d9bab8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/7cd99e1bede44bbc19820e64c0b0d1618a958be9.png[/img]

[b]MODERATE TWEAKS[/b]

Black Heart was definitely a very overtuned character, having no serious weaknesses while being capable of some of the most terrifying mix-ups and knockdown pressure in the game. With these changes, we've attempted to better accentuate his intended weaknesses while keeping his strengths intact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/b21608e79ee05db993bf979ba8784b14ab1ebdf1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/3d0e66f6ae0eac796287ec854bc73d3640199333.png[/img]
