notes.title: A Jolly Crimbo Update! Version 0.6.3 is Live!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays, Duelists!

This small, semi-holiday-themed content update adds a handful of new costumes and Missions, fixes quite a few bugs, and adds the previously Mission-exclusive Cube City stage to the stage select!

Also, to quickly answer a question many players new to the Steam release have understandably been asking: No, Duels of Fortune will sadly not be getting online play. We would honestly love to, but it's just not possible. This is mainly because we were very clueless when we first started making the game (not surprising considering we were both still in [i]high school[/i]), and the old framework that the game is built on simply is not compatible with online. Without getting into technical talk, the game would desync a LOT, and there'd be nothing we could do about. The only way to add online would be to essentially restart development from scratch; a monumental task that we -- a team of just two people with an extremely low budget -- are not willing to undertake. If we had to do that, we'd rather just make a new game.

[b]TL;DR:[/b] Duels of Fortune will not have online play because this game is built on spaghetti code and a dream. Sorry about that. We hope our bigger focus on singleplayer content will make up for it!

notes.title: Post-Release Status Update, and Our Current Plans For 2024
notes.content:
Hello, Duelists! 

Whether you've been with us for years, or you're brand-new to the community, we hope you've been enjoying your time with Duels of Fortune so far! It's warmed our silly little hearts to see so much love for the game and to see so many new people picking it up for the first time! We seriously appreciate everyone who's taken the time to play, share, or review the game, it means a lot to us!

We'd like to take this opportunity to provide you all with an update on what the two of us devs are currently doing, and what we [i]plan[/i] to be doing over the course of the next year. This'll be a bit of a chunky read, so you might wanna get comfortable! And just be aware that anything we say here is subject to change.

Also, as a quick note, we have an [url=discord.gg/R5vVYyR]official Discord server[/url] where we often talk about our short-term and long-term plans for the game, so if you want to be the first to know about said plans going forward, be sure to join up! It's a super chill place with lots of great people, and we're very casual with our community over there, so don't be afraid to say hi!

Now then, onto the important stuff!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Crimbo 2023 Update![/h1]
Right around the corner is our yearly Crimbo Update! This is a small content update we do every December, which typically includes a few new wintery or holiday-themed costumes! This year is, of course, no exception!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/d8e0e6236d4de5adb6399d7ba3b2ea00bf772d51.png[/img] [i]Tomatoes may not be in season, but Ember sure looks cozy in those PJ's![/i]

This year's winter costume lineup will consist of the frosty [b]Snow Callowman[/b], the comfy [b]Tomato Ember[/b], and a [b]third costume[/b] we'll reveal at a later date!

The Crimbo Update should ideally release [b]right around Christmas[/b], and will also include fixes for some of the bugs reported since the Steam release!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]New Fighters![/h1]
Naturally, we plan to add plenty of new playable fighters to the roster throughout next year! While the order is largely undecided as of right now, here's a little teaser of at least the next two!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/7bdc4db6037fcc8877a44ad08fd70447ab8e3dbd.png[/img]
[h3][b]AZUTRON S-TYPE[/b][/h3]
A speedy [b]pixie character[/b] who can position himself practically anywhere in the blink of an eye, [b]Azutron[/b]'s highly versatile skillset can keep opponents on their toes nonstop! He's one of the many robots of his kind that make up the interdimensional military police force known as the Azu-Corps.
[list]
[*] A lightning-fast fighter whose Special moves all aid his movement in some way, including an insane [b]8-way teleport[/b]!
[*] Rush your opponent down and create deadly mixups, or kite them with your speed and punish their every mistake! Azutron's crazy mobility opens up [b]tons of options[/b]!
[*] Keep an eye on your [b]overheat meter[/b]! Get too carried away with your teleport and other movement tools, and it might blow up in your face, [i]literally![/i]
[/list]
Azutron will be the next fighter added to the game, and he should be on track for a [b]February 2024[/b] release!

[h3][b]"SAMURAI"[/b][/h3]
Sorry, but we're keeping details about this mysterious fighter under wraps for now (yes, even their name)! What we can say, though, is that they'll be very important to the story of a certain electricity-wielding karate student...

You can likely expect this character sometime in [b]Q2 2024[/b]!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Story Mode![/h1]
[i]In the year 2014, nearly the entire population of Earth possesses unique, super-powered abilities known as Aspects. Thanks to those wanting to show off the power of their Aspects, and to watch other people's Aspects in action, fighting tournaments have risen in popularity more than ever. And this year, the single biggest tournament ever held is about to take place: the Duels of Fortune![/i]

With most of the pieces now in place, 2024 will be the year we FINALLY start working on Duels of Fortune's Story Mode!

Once we finish writing the script and developing the cutscene system (both of which are already work-in-progress), we intend to start off with the prologue and first 2 chapters, and release those all at once. After that, we'd ideally like to release chapters in similar batches alongside new characters, though we're currently not sure how feasible that is.

Regardless, this is a story we've been gradually cooking up for over 5 years now, and we couldn't be more excited to finally begin to tell it! We currently have no solid estimate of when the first batch of Story Mode chapters will release, but we'll give an update later on when we're more confident!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Rolling Rampage![/h1]
Hey wait, this isn't DoF! What gives?

Well, for those unaware, we've been taking a short break from working on Duels of Fortune over the past couple months. During this time, we've instead dedicated ourselves to learning the Godot engine, and Rolling Rampage is the result of that! It's a small endless-runner-style game (though not at all endless, in our case) where you play as a spherical alien named Zorb, tearing up the streets and causing as much mayhem as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/962d7ce326e86d89a8a22337b90c99826f833d3f.gif[/img]
[i]You might recognize Zorb, as he was featured as one of DoF's Mission mode bosses![/i]

We're planning to wrap up this project very soon, releasing it on itch.io [b]sometime around the new year[/b]! We had originally planned to start another small project after this, but we've instead decided we'll be going back to full-focusing Duels of Fortune for the time being!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Well, that about covers everything we wanted to share! Aside from the Crimbo update, we plan to take it easy for the rest of this year, but in 2024 we're ready to dive straight back into Duels of Fortune with FULL FORCE!!

Once again, thanks a ton for all the support you've given us, and we hope you look forward to the exciting additions to come!

Enjoy your holidays, and have a happy new year!
- Ben and Kaleb
